name: Mindbody
description: Studio and gym management in Mindbody: locations, programs, classes and schedules, rosters and waiting lists, appointments and free slots, enrollments, clients with passes, memberships, contracts and visits, sales, pricing options, products and staff. Books classes and appointments and manages clients.
instructions:
## Mindbody
This connector works with the **Mindbody Public API v6** (`https://api.mindbodyonline.com/public/v6`) for fitness studios, gyms, yoga and wellness businesses: site, locations, programs and session types, classes and class schedules, rosters and waiting lists, appointments and free slots, enrollments, clients with their passes, memberships, contracts, visits and purchases, sales, pricing options, products and staff. It books clients into classes, enrollments and appointments, updates appointments, creates and updates clients, checks clients in and adds contact logs.

**Setup (10 minutes)**
1. Create a developer account at https://developers.mindbodyonline.com and copy the **API key** of your source from the API credentials page. Until Mindbody approves the account for live sites, it works with the public sandbox site.
2. The site owner activates your source for the site: get the activation link for the site id from the developer portal (or the API's `/site/activationcode`) and the owner opens it while signed in to Mindbody.
3. Paste the key into `MINDBODY_API_KEY` and the site id (a number, shown in the business's Mindbody URL and settings) into `MINDBODY_SITE_ID`. The public sandbox site has the id -99.
4. Enter the user name and password of a **staff member** of that site into `MINDBODY_USERNAME` and `MINDBODY_PASSWORD` (use a dedicated staff login with only the permissions the AI needs). The connector exchanges them for a staff user token at `/usertoken/issue` and renews it automatically.
5. Run `mindbody_get_locations` to check the connection.

**Workflow**
- Site set-up: `mindbody_get_sites`, `mindbody_get_locations`, `mindbody_get_programs`, `mindbody_get_session_types`, `mindbody_get_resources`, `mindbody_get_staff`, `mindbody_get_staff_session_types`.
- Class timetable: `mindbody_get_classes` (today by default; set start_date_time and end_date_time), `mindbody_get_class_descriptions`, `mindbody_get_class_schedules`, roster with `mindbody_get_class_visits`, waiting lists with `mindbody_get_waitlist_entries`.
- Book a class: find the client (`mindbody_get_clients`), check a pass with `mindbody_get_client_services` (class_id), then `mindbody_add_client_to_class`; cancel with `mindbody_remove_client_from_class`; drop a waiting list entry with `mindbody_remove_from_waitlist`.
- Appointments: free slots with `mindbody_get_bookable_items` or `mindbody_get_available_dates`, then `mindbody_add_appointment`; booked ones with `mindbody_get_staff_appointments` and the staff calendar with `mindbody_get_schedule_items`; change, confirm, mark arrived or cancel with `mindbody_update_appointment`.
- Enrollments (workshops, courses): `mindbody_get_enrollments`, `mindbody_add_client_to_enrollment`.
- Clients: `mindbody_get_clients`, `mindbody_get_client_complete_info`, `mindbody_get_client_visits`, `mindbody_get_client_schedule`, `mindbody_get_client_services`, `mindbody_get_active_client_memberships`, `mindbody_get_client_contracts`, `mindbody_get_client_purchases`, `mindbody_get_client_account_balances`, `mindbody_get_contact_logs`. New client: `mindbody_get_client_duplicates`, `mindbody_get_required_client_fields`, then `mindbody_add_client`; change with `mindbody_update_client`; check in at the front desk with `mindbody_add_arrival`; note a call with `mindbody_add_contact_log`.
- Sales and catalog: `mindbody_get_sales`, `mindbody_get_transactions`, `mindbody_get_services` (pricing options), `mindbody_get_contracts`, `mindbody_get_packages`, `mindbody_get_products`.

**Switched off at install**: `mindbody_cancel_single_class`; it cannot be undone, so an admin switches it on when the team needs it.

**Test mode**: most writes take `test: true`, which validates the request and returns the result without saving. Use it when unsure.

**Reading the answers**
- Responses wrap the rows in a named list (`Classes`, `Clients`, `Appointments`, `Sales`, ...) next to `PaginationResponse` with `RequestedLimit`, `RequestedOffset`, `PageSize` and `TotalResults`. Field names are PascalCase.
- Client ids are strings (`ClientId`, often a number in text form, set by the business); `UniqueId` is Mindbody's numeric id. Class, appointment, staff, location and program ids are integers.
- Dates and times are in the **site's time zone**, without an offset (`2026-11-20T18:00:00`). Money is in the site currency, in major units.
- A class is one occurrence; its `ClassDescription` is the class type and its `ClassScheduleId` the recurring schedule.

**Paging**: `limit` (default 100, at most 200) and `offset`. Next page: offset + limit, until offset reaches `TotalResults`.

**Limits and errors**: Mindbody counts API calls per site and bills them beyond a free allowance (see the pricing in the developer portal), so filter by date, location or ids instead of reading everything. 401 means a wrong API key, an inactive source for the site or a rejected staff login (`DeniedAccess`, `InvalidSiteId`); 403 a staff permission missing; 400 a business rule with the reason in `Error.Message` (for example no pricing option, class full, outside the booking window).
prerequisites: A Mindbody developer account with an API key activated for the site, the site id, and a staff login of that site.

MINDBODY_API_KEY.label: API key
MINDBODY_API_KEY.help: developers.mindbodyonline.com, API credentials: the API key of your source. Sent in the Api-Key header.
MINDBODY_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the API key, without spaces or quotes.

MINDBODY_SITE_ID.label: Site ID
MINDBODY_SITE_ID.help: The numeric id of the business's Mindbody site, which must have activated your source. The sandbox site is -99.
MINDBODY_SITE_ID.patternMessage: The site id is a number, for example 123456 (or -99 for the sandbox).

MINDBODY_USERNAME.label: Staff user name
MINDBODY_USERNAME.help: User name (often the email) of a staff member of the site, used to get a staff user token.

verifyHints.401: Mindbody refused the login. Check the API key, that the source is activated for this site id, and the staff user name and password.
verifyHints.403: The staff member lacks a permission for this call. Give the staff login the needed permissions in Mindbody.

tools.name: mindbody_add_client_to_class
tools.description: Book a client into a class. With waitlist true the client joins the waiting list when the class is full. Mindbody uses a fitting pricing option of the client unless client_service_id is given; require_payment false books without one.

waitlist.description: Add to the waiting list if the class is full.

require_payment.description: false to book without a pricing option (the visit stays unpaid).

client_service_id.description: Pricing option of the client to pay with, from mindbody_get_client_services.

send_email.description: Send the client the confirmation email set up in Mindbody.

test.description: true to validate the request without saving anything (Mindbody test mode).

tools.name: mindbody_remove_client_from_class
tools.description: Cancel a client's booking in a class. late_cancel true records it as a late cancel, which can use up a visit or charge a fee under the site's policy.

send_email.description: Send the client the confirmation email set up in Mindbody.

test.description: true to validate the request without saving anything (Mindbody test mode).

tools.name: mindbody_remove_from_waitlist
tools.description: Remove clients from class waiting lists by waiting list entry id, for example when they no longer want a spot.

waitlist_entry_ids.description: Waiting list entry ids, from mindbody_get_waitlist_entries.

tools.name: mindbody_add_appointment

start_date_time.description: Start. Date and time, ISO 8601 (2026-11-20 or 2026-11-20T18:00:00), in the site's time zone.

end_date_time.description: End; default start plus the session length. Date and time, ISO 8601 (2026-11-20 or 2026-11-20T18:00:00), in the site's time zone.

duration.description: Length in minutes, instead of end_date_time.

staff_requested.description: The client asked for this staff member.

apply_payment.description: Pay with a fitting pricing option of the client (default true).

send_email.description: Send the client the confirmation email set up in Mindbody.

test.description: true to validate the request without saving anything (Mindbody test mode).

tools.name: mindbody_add_client
tools.description: Create a client profile. Check mindbody_get_client_duplicates first and mindbody_get_required_client_fields for the fields the site requires.

gender.description: Gender as configured in the site (for example Female, Male).

country.description: Country code, for example US or DE.

test.description: true to validate the request without saving anything (Mindbody test mode).

tools.name: mindbody_update_client
tools.description: Update a client profile. client holds the client id and only the fields to change, for example {"Id": "100000123", "Email": "new@example.com", "MobilePhone": "..."}.

client.description: Client fields in Mindbody names: Id (required), FirstName, LastName, Email, MobilePhone, BirthDate, AddressLine1, City, PostalCode, Country, Notes, Status, ...

cross_regional_update.description: Also update the client on the organization's other sites (default true).

test.description: true to validate the request without saving anything (Mindbody test mode).

tools.name: mindbody_add_contact_log
tools.description: Add a contact log to a client: a note about a call, email or visit, optionally assigned to staff with a follow-up date.

contact_method.description: How the contact happened or should happen, for example Email, Phone, InPerson, Text.

assigned_to_staff_id.description: Staff member responsible for the follow-up.

followup_by_date.description: Follow-up date. Date and time, ISO 8601 (2026-11-20 or 2026-11-20T18:00:00), in the site's time zone.

enroll_date_forward.description: Enroll in sessions from this date on. Date and time, ISO 8601 (2026-11-20 or 2026-11-20T18:00:00), in the site's time zone.

enroll_open.description: Enroll on these open dates only.

waitlist.description: Join the waiting list if full.
